autoRecall.description: Inject relevant memories into context before each agent turn

recallMaxResults.description: Maximum number of memory search results to inject per turn

recallMinScore.description: Minimum similarity score for auto-recall results

alignmentCheck.description: Enable per-turn alignment drift scoring via Flash Lite LLM call

alignmentCheckObserveOnly.description: When true, log alignment scores but do not inject corrections (safe calibration mode)

alignmentCheckCooldownTurns.description: Minimum number of turns between alignment checks

alignmentCheckThreshold.description: Score below which a correction is injected (0.0-1.0, lower = more permissive)
